import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int INF = 1000000000;

    static class FlowGraph {
        int n;
        int[][] cap;
        List<List<Integer>> adj;
        int[] level;
        int[] iter;

        FlowGraph(int size) {
            n = size;
            cap = new int[n][n];
            adj = new ArrayList<>(size);
            for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
                adj.add(new ArrayList<>());
            }
            level = new int[n];
            iter = new int[n];
        }

        void connect(int u, int v, int c) {
            cap[u][v] = c;
            adj.get(u).add(v);
            adj.get(v).add(u);
        }

        boolean levelize(int s, int t) {
            Arrays.fill(level, -1);
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            q.offer(s);
            level[s] = 0;
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int u = q.poll();
                for (int v : adj.get(u)) {
                    if (level[v] == -1 && cap[u][v] > 0) {
                        level[v] = level[u] + 1;
                        q.offer(v);
                    }
                }
            }
            return level[t] != -1;
        }

        int augment(int u, int t, int flow) {
            if (u == t) return flow;
            for (int i = iter[u]; i < adj.get(u).size(); i++) {
                iter[u] = i;
                int v = adj.get(u).get(i);
                if (level[v] == level[u] + 1 && cap[u][v] > 0) {
                    int pushed = augment(v, t, Math.min(flow, cap[u][v]));
                    if (pushed > 0) {
                        cap[u][v] -= pushed;
                        cap[v][u] += pushed;
                        return pushed;
                    }
                }
            }
            return 0;
        }

        int flow(int s, int t) {
            int total = 0;
            while (levelize(s, t)) {
                Arrays.fill(iter, 0);
                int pushed;
                while ((pushed = augment(s, t, INF)) > 0) {
                    total += pushed;
                }
            }
            return total;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String[] firstLine = br.readLine().split(" ");
        int n = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[0]);
        int t = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[1]);
        
        String[] field = new String[n];
        String[] capsule = new String[n];
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            field[i] = br.readLine();
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            capsule[i] = br.readLine();
        }
        
        int zx = -1, zy = -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (field[i].charAt(j) == 'Z') {
                    zx = i;
                    zy = j;
                }
            }
        }
        
        int source = 2 * n * n;
        int target = source + 1;
        FlowGraph g = new FlowGraph(2 * n * n + 2);
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                char c = capsule[i].charAt(j);
                if (Character.isDigit(c)) {
                    g.connect(i * n + j + n * n, target, c - '0');
                }
            }
        }
        
        int[][] distZ = new int[n][n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(distZ[i], INF);
        }
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        distZ[zx][zy] = 0;
        q.offer(new int[]{zx, zy});
        int[] dx = {-1, 1, 0, 0};
        int[] dy = {0, 0, -1, 1};
        
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cell = q.poll();
            int x = cell[0];
            int y = cell[1];
            if (distZ[x][y] == t) continue;
            for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                int nx = x + dx[d];
                int ny = y + dy[d];
                if (nx >= 0 && nx < n && ny >= 0 && ny < n && capsule[nx].charAt(ny) != 'Y' && distZ[nx][ny] == INF) {
                    distZ[nx][ny] = distZ[x][y] + 1;
                    char c = capsule[nx].charAt(ny);
                    if (Character.isDigit(c)) {
                        g.connect(zx * n + zy, nx * n + ny + n * n, INF);
                    }
                    q.offer(new int[]{nx, ny});
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (Character.isDigit(field[i].charAt(j))) {
                    g.connect(source, i * n + j, field[i].charAt(j) - '0');
                    int[][] distS = new int[n][n];
                    for (int k = 0; k < n; k++) {
                        Arrays.fill(distS[k], INF);
                    }
                    Queue<int[]> q2 = new LinkedList<>();
                    distS[i][j] = 0;
                    q2.offer(new int[]{i, j});
                    while (!q2.isEmpty()) {
                        int[] cell = q2.poll();
                        int x = cell[0];
                        int y = cell[1];
                        if (distS[x][y] == t) continue;
                        for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                            int nx = x + dx[d];
                            int ny = y + dy[d];
                            if (nx >= 0 && nx < n && ny >= 0 && ny < n && capsule[nx].charAt(ny) != 'Y' && distS[nx][ny] == INF) {
                                distS[nx][ny] = distS[x][y] + 1;
                                char c = capsule[nx].charAt(ny);
                                if (Character.isDigit(c)) {
                                    g.connect(i * n + j, nx * n + ny + n * n, INF);
                                }
                                q2.offer(new int[]{nx, ny});
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        System.out.println(g.flow(source, target));
    }
}
